Indian Constitution & Rights

The Indian Constitution, patient rights and duties, and legal rights relevant to nursing practice.

🎯 After this chapter you can

  • Describe the Preamble, fundamental rights and duties
  • List the rights of the patient
  • Explain the duties of the nurse
  • Apply rights and duties in practice

In simple words

The Constitution is the supreme law of India. It guarantees the rights of every citizen and sets the duties we owe to one another. Health care works inside that framework.

Fundamental rights

Right Meaning
Right to equality Equal treatment, no discrimination
Right to life and dignity Includes access to health care
Right against exploitation Protection from trafficking and forced labour
Right to freedom Movement, profession, protection of privacy
Right to freedom of religion Share in culture and religion
Right to constitutional remedies Go to court for violation of rights

Fundamental duties

Respect the national flag, anthem, Constitution and ideals; protect the sovereignty of the country; promote harmony; safeguard public property; protect the environment; and strive for excellence in work.

Rights of the patient

  • Right to know the diagnosis, treatment and costs
  • Right to informed consent
  • Right to privacy and confidentiality
  • Right to refuse or leave treatment
  • Right to complain and seek second opinion
  • Right to safety from harm
  • Right to equal treatment regardless of status

Duties of the nurse

  • Give competent, safe and ethical care
  • Maintain accurate and timely records
  • Respect dignity, privacy and confidentiality
  • Report hazards, errors and complaints honestly
  • Follow orders within competence; clarify when not sure
  • Keep knowledge current; be honest in court

🔴 Rights carry duties

Every right has a matching duty. The patient has the right to information; the nurse has the duty to give information in a language the patient understands.

🔴 Most important for exams

  1. Fundamental rights: equality, life and dignity, freedom, and constitutional remedies.
  2. Right to life includes access to health care.
  3. Patients have the right to informed consent and privacy.
  4. Nurses must document accurately and keep confidentiality.
  5. Article for remedy of rights violation is the right to constitutional remedies.

⭐ Important for exams

  1. Fundamental duties include respect for national symbols and environment.
  2. Refusal of treatment must be documented with an informed refusal.
  3. Right to second opinion should never be obstructed.
  4. Consumer protection acts safeguard patients from negligence.
  5. Nurses must protect children and vulnerable adults.

📌 Memory trick

Patient rights: I-C-P-R-S — Information, Consent, Privacy, Refusal right, Safety.

60-second revision

  • Constitution: fundamental rights and duties.
  • Right to life and dignity includes health care.
  • Patient rights: information, consent, privacy, refusal, complaint, safety.
  • Nurse’s duties: competence, safety, records, confidentiality.
  • Every right has a matching duty.

Test yourself

Which fundamental right includes access to health care?

Answer: A. The right to life and personal dignity has been interpreted to include the right to health care.

The patient’s right to know the diagnosis is part of:

Answer: B. Patients have the right to honest, understandable information about their condition and treatment.

A patient refuses treatment. The nurse must:

Answer: B. A competent patient may refuse; the nurse documents the informed refusal and informs the doctor.

Which is a fundamental duty?

Answer: B. Protecting public property is a fundamental duty; the other options are rights.

Which of these is always the nurse’s duty?

Answer: B. Accurate, timely documentation is both a nursing duty and a legal protection.
